comment: Retrieval evaluation for Phase 2 semantic search (phase2-spec §10). Forty questions in a reader's own words, deliberately avoiding each document's distinctive wording, so full-text search alone should miss most of them. Written from the corpus truth texts and from knowledge of the public-domain books on 2026-11-09, before any semantic search was built, and not edited to fit it. Document ids are spikes/extraction-bench/corpus/manifest.json's. A question passes when any relevant document is in the top 5 results of hybrid search.
